prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofer for hail damage in Denver — the right contractor depends on your location, your property type, the scope of damage, your insurance needs and schedule. I can, however, help you pick the best one for your situation. To get a great roofer, I recommend the steps and vetting checklist below — and I can find and compare top-rated local contractors if you share your ZIP code or neighborhood.

How to find the best roofer for hail damage
- Get multiple bids: obtain at least 3 written estimates so you can compare scope, materials, and price.
- Choose contractors experienced with hail and insurance claims: they should be familiar with Xactimate, documenting damage for claims, and working with adjusters.
- Verify credentials: check business license/registration for Denver, current insurance (general liability and workers’ comp), and any local or industry affiliations (e.g., manufacturer-certified installer).
- Check reputation: read recent Google/Yelp/Angi reviews, BBB rating, and ask for local references and before/after photos of hail repairs.
- Confirm warranties: get both material (manufacturer) and workmanship warranties in writing.
- Ask about timetables and materials: confirm brand/type of shingles, underlayment, ventilation, and how they’ll address decking/structural issues.
- Understand payment terms: avoid large up-front payments (standard is a modest deposit), insist on a written contract and lien releases when final payment is made.
- Avoid storm-chasers/scams: be wary of door-to-door solicitors or contractors who pressure you to sign immediately or ask for full payment up front.

Questions to ask a roofer
- How many hail-damage repairs have you done in Denver in the last year?
- Will you provide a written inspection report and photo documentation?
- Will you work directly with my insurance company and help with the claim?
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle brand you propose?
- What’s your warranty on workmanship? How long is it?
- Can you provide recent local references and projects I can inspect?

Red flags
- No written contract or scope of work
- Pushy sales tactics, high-pressure sign-up
- Requests for full payment up front in cash
- Lack of insurance proof or license/registration
- Extremely low bid that’s much less than others

If you want, I can:
- Look up top-rated Denver roofing companies that specialize in hail repair near you (tell me your ZIP or neighborhood)
- Review estimates or quotes you’ve received and highlight differences
- Draft a checklist of what to include in a contract

Which would you prefer?
